patch.why: A dead-end leaf for engineering, included to show the mapping honestly. Real radiators and panels are 3D, multi-material, with radiative (not insulated) boundaries, and thermal engineers compute their modes numerically for every geometry. The theorem confirms an intuition (slowest insulated thermal mode peaks at edges) and could inform sensor-placement heuristics for thin insulated plates; it changes no design. Effect on space thermal engineering: nil to negligible. Conditional: 369 is T1 (no Lean main result), so the band is one step below a checked result.

patch.why: Ringdown spectroscopy (LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA now, LISA after 2035) and EHT/BHEX photon-ring tests all assume a perturbed black hole relaxes to Kerr. Kerr stability proves it from outside; strong cosmic censorship near Kerr (264) says the interior generically cannot be continued past the Cauchy horizon with square-integrable connection; Penrose inequalities (260) bound mass below by horizon area for moving, charged and rotating data. Review bandwidth is the gate: a few dozen people can referee these, and 722 manuscripts arrived at once (tr-position-5). Formal checking is further off because Lean lacks Lorentzian geometry, so S1 is Medium; S2/S3 add AI-assisted refereeing and formalization. patch.why: These four families are the release's only direct contact with structural mechanics. 372 tells inspection engineers that full boundary data determine elastic stiffness in principle; it says nothing about how stably, and Calderon-type problems are typically only logarithmically stable (general), so it raises confidence without changing tools. 366 underpins the Griffith/Francfort-Marigo variational fracture energies behind phase-field fracture codes: minimizing crack sets are well-behaved in 2D. 368 is a technical tool for nonlinear-elasticity existence and approximation theory (invertible deformations), relevant to large-deformation finite elements. The conductivity-nonuniqueness half of 365 is a negative result: some conductivities cannot be recovered from one boundary patch, a potential ceiling for electrical-resistance damage sensing in carbon-fiber structures (conditional on the T3 premise and on the counterexample class being physically relevant). Under S2, AI-assisted formalization of PDE catches up (2028), so confirmation by 2031 is likely. The 372, 366 and 368 parts are conditional (T1, no Lean main results), so bands are one step down.

patch.why: DFT is the workhorse for screening alloys, ceramics, semiconductors, battery electrolytes and propellant chemistry. If 278 holds, some ensemble densities (fractional occupations, open-shell and excited-state ensembles: the regime of transition-metal oxides, defect levels and radiation-damage centres) cannot be reproduced by any Kohn-Sham reference even with the exact functional. If 275 holds, no efficient algorithm computes ground-state energies of all molecules and solids (classically, and on quantum computers unless BQP = QMA). Ceiling results act within months (P3): they tell method developers to stop seeking one universal functional and to invest in domain-specific, data-driven corrections and targeted high-level methods. Band: P3 defaults to High; one band down in every scenario because the ceilings are conditional on 278 and 275 (T1). notes:
A3 calibration and rule-compliance pass on graph-v0 (2026-10-07). Only update edits; every patch carries a calibration_note starting "A3:". Fields touched: earliest_year, band_2031, premise_tier, binding_gate, and why for 9 nodes (see WHY PATCHES). Edges, titles and branches untouched.

CHECKS RUN (scripted over all 360 nodes): shared tier-0 timings vs capability.json (all 11 matched, no change); scenario invariants (none broken before or after); hard-prerequisite year order (none broken before or after); hard-prerequisite band order, i.e. a node cannot be likelier by 2031 than something it hard-requires (12 scenario-level breaches in v0: 9 resolved by these updates; the 3 on auton-certified-assembly-skills, plus 3 created on struct-shm-inverse-limits by the T1 drop on its prerequisite, need edge changes, see EDGE RECOMMENDATIONS); tier 5-6 lag after prerequisites against the physclock lag ladder; T1/T2 premises without "conditional" in why (about 40 flagged by regex; most were non-load-bearing links, handled by relabelling premise_tier to "n/a (...)" with the conditional note); premise tiers above T3 for openai/math (cap-autoformalization relabelled); catalog families (all valid, none of 107/109/130 used, galactic speedups only mentioned as non-practical); regulatory or qualification gate with a High band; tier-7 High bands.

1 LAG LADDER (tier 5-6). Rule applied: a node whose hardware or flight software design depends on a capability arriving in year Y flies no earlier than Y+1 for a smallsat or derivative payload (12-18 months, about 8-14 months at the S3 physical multiplier), Y+2-3 for a new launch-vehicle subsystem or primary structure, 4-6 years for a reactor from a funded start. Fixed: capability-ai-native-spacecraft (S3), auton-verified-autonomy-lunar-flight (S3), hyper-thinner-tps-flown (S3), verif-verified-onboard-stack (all), materials-closed-loop-discovery (S2/S3, replication), materials-perovskite-tandem-flight (S1), auton-lunar-o2-flight-demo (S1), auton-mars-isru-demo (S2/S3), struct-flown-lighter-structure (S2/S3 to 2031, primary structure), struct-shm-inspection-credit, struct-radiator-lightweight-production, physclock-reactor-in-space, comms-pq-fleet-migration, plus followers struct-structural-mass-step, struct-reusable-life-management, struct-100kw-per-tonne-fleet, struct-gw-orbital-compute. Left alone on purpose where the AI input is process or software that can be loaded on hardware already flying, not a new design: materials-cots-orbital-compute-ops, hyper-rapid-reuse-heatshield, comms-certified-mesh-operations, comms-d2d-coexistence-scheduling, verif-constellation-verified-updates, auton-ai-planned-ops-routine, physclock-licensing-in-weeks, science-lisa-readiness, astro-ai-designed-trajectory-flown (a trajectory is not hardware).
